name: Notible Sync
description: Keep this workspace the same on your own computers through your Google Drive. Everything is encrypted on your computer first, so neither Notible nor Google can read it.
author: Notible
guide:
Open **Settings → Plugins → Notible Sync** and sign in with Google.

On your first computer, start syncing. On the next one, sign in with the same Google account and pair it with the first: the key stays on your computers, never on Drive.

Sync runs in the background; **Secure Sync: sync now** in Hotkeys runs it at once. Nothing is merged or deleted behind your back: a change made on two computers at once keeps both copies.
